text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day after work, I stepped outside to 
go for a stroll――

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I've been waiting for you! Judging by 
that look, it seems your work is finished.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I wanted to spend time with you 
today... There is something I simply must 
convey to you.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: And that is... my love, from me to you.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
――I've been quite indebted to this costume 
rental shop. Whenever I slip my arms 
through these clothes and step onto the 
stage, a resolute feeling welled up within 
me from each and every outfit!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Well then, would you mind changing into 
this silk coordinated outfit?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I spent sleepless nights thinking and 
choosing it. An attire worthy of receiving 
this love.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tried changing as told. Into such formal 
attire, well... No, I'm getting nervous.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
choice_data_list: Ah, um... Does it not suit me?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Perfetto... It is so utterly perfect that 
it took my breath away!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Perfetta... It is so utterly perfect that 
it took my breath away!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now, allow me to escort you. My beloved 
principe...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now, allow me to escort you. My beloved 
principessa...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I still couldn't read the situation, but 
being praised honestly felt pretty 
good...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next, we visited an art museum. It had an 
intellectual, solemn atmosphere, but 
thanks to the outfit, I didn't feel 
intimidated.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
They say contemporary art from all over 
the world is gathered here. Fufu, I'm 
looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but what a dilemma. Even though we 
came to appreciate the art... I simply 
cannot take my eyes off of you.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And every time you gaze back, my heart 
goes *con brio*— This is truly a dazzling, 
whirlwind of love.
choice_data_list:
(...Is "love" a current trend of hers, I 
wonder?)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
They were all avant-garde, truly 
bellissima works of art, weren't they? I'm 
so glad I could view them with you.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right. The taste of this soy 
milk latte, does it ring a bell? It uses 
the soy milk from that shopping district 
overflowing with love.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
It brings back memories... of your chorus. 
Even now, your singing strikes a chord 
within my heart...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Walking around all over, it was a fun day. 
However, her true intentions remained 
unknown...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now, here comes the finale. Would you mind 
closing your eyes for just a moment?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
choice_data_list: Is this... the sound of a violin?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now, open your eyes. We dedicate our 
musica of love solely to you!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I've been waiting, Trainer-san♡

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for the fan 
meet-and-greet. Since then, I've gotten 
much better at conveying love, and my 
popularity has been skyrocketing!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
This is a token of my gratitude... Here. 
An assortment of Loyce-chan merch. Feel my 
love anytime, okay?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe is here too. The love of soy 
milk still exists.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Transmitting again and again. Does love 
still exist within you too?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll always love this soy milk...!
Yup, I'll always love this soy milk...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
You see, we have received so much amore 
from you.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Your words, which made us realize that 
love is not a one-way street.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Your kindness in singing aloud the love of 
soy milk together with us.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Everything is your love! Amore! Amore!! 
Amore!!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
To that precious love of yours, we wished 
to respond with a fortissimo love!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So that's why she kept whispering love... 
In all earnestness, to convey her feelings 
of gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
How was it... Was I able to reward your 
love today?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you! What a trainer you are! That 
smile captures my heart and never lets 
go...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Once more, I dedicate the full measure of 
my feelings. Please, accept this sheet 
music!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The realization of love, memories of 
singing about love, a date filled with 
love... I packed it all inside.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Music is the ultimate pinnacle of love 
that I can express. Thank you... my amore.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The happiness of loving and being loved 
filled my chest. Treasuring everything I 
received, I savored the feeling over and 
over again.
